counting_policy.all_attempts: Sum every distinct (stage ID, stage attempt ID, task ID) TaskEnd once; includes failed, killed and speculative attempts and unsuccessful stages.
counting_policy.logical_successful_tasks: Observed approximation: for each successfully completed stage ID and partition, select the highest stage attempt not later than its last successful completion, then earliest successful finish/task ID. This includes reusable earlier-attempt outputs and excludes duplicate speculative successes; it is not a measurement of bytes physically saved.
counting_policy.jobs: Job metrics include referenced stage IDs; shared/reused stages can appear in multiple jobs. Job totals are NOT additive. Application totals count stages only once.
counting_policy.job_groups: Each executed stage attempt is assigned to its StageSubmitted.Properties spark.jobGroup.id, falling back only to one unambiguous referencing JobStart group. Group resources are disjoint across stage attempts; jobs are NOT summed. observed_stage_window_ms is the first stage submission to last completion, not Python pipeline wall time.
counting_policy.duration: Finish Time minus Launch Time, milliseconds; p50/p95 use linear interpolation and successful attempts only.
counting_policy.shuffle_read: Remote Bytes Read + Local Bytes Read; Remote Bytes Read To Disk is a subset and is not added twice.
counting_policy.units: Bytes and records are integers; executor CPU and shuffle-write time are nanoseconds; executor run, GC, fetch wait and task duration are milliseconds.
counting_policy.missing_metrics: Absent resource counters contribute zero; inspect warnings and tasks_missing_metrics before treating totals as complete.
